subject: C6o freeze: offset-key work reverted out of the tree (private patch); tree compiles; correction to the 1.5% figure
body:
1) The tree is clean of my offset-key work. These files are back to their pre-work bytes:
- air_bridge.rs fa526ae6 (md5). This is the source of the current host .so (10-27 06:22).
- air_bridge.h 37a7b77c, render_pipeline.inc 5d289550, frame_bench_main.m 815fb91a.
- render_encoder.inc is b897444e. It still holds lowering-opus's in-flight TEGU_PASS_MRT trace hunk, which I left alone.
- Both translator checkouts (references/metal2vulkan-tegu-pin and gpu/build/metal2vulkan) are back to a clean 68dffde.
The iOS -Werror syntax check (full define set) gives rc=0. The host cdylib build failed at compile time, so nothing was installed. HEAVY RELEASE is posted.

2) Private patches for after C6o are in gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/offset-templates/:
- frontend-offset-templates.patch, sha256 701da21b…
- translator-buffer-slot-templates.patch, sha256 a0fbaac5…
Status: the C side passes the iOS syntax check. The Rust side is not yet compiled: one non_exhaustive Window match has been fixed in my working copy but not rebuilt. It is untested on host, so it is NOT a stable point.

3) Your question about shipping the export: no, it was not safe as-is. It needed the uncommitted translator accessor, so a C6o build against the pin would have failed to compile. That is why I reverted the hunk. Nothing ships.

4) Correction to my 1.5% note. It was wrong. The c6m ui60 device log (hardware-20261025/c6m-test/ui60-usb/xnu-live.log), summed over all TEGU_PERF_ENCODE windows:
- plan_ms 9419 of draw_ms 19482 (48% of draw encode)
- plan_miss 65896 against plan_hit 155634
- PLANMISS causes: offset 61346 (93%), other 3266, cold 1284
- About 0.14 ms per miss on the device's slow big cores
In the last windows that is 80–209 ms of planning per 2 s window. So offset keys are worth roughly 40–45% of draw-encode CPU, not 1.5%. I suggest landing the patch right after C6o, once it is host-validated (TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY re-plans every hit; frame_bench FB_OFFSET_RING scenario).
Design: entries are keyed by bind-shape classes (offset_alignment, length_class). Each hit is rebased from bridge-supplied per-slot templates: descriptor range, residual and guest-base push positions, binding fields. Every template is probed once against a fresh plan with a moved offset. Kill switch: NORD2_METAL_PLAN_TEMPLATES=0.

5) Next, after C6o, as you asked: the 55 creation-time AIR misses (fixed_frag variant 4, 175–318 ms each) — background translation at pipeline creation and what CA semantics allow. I will report a design before touching code.
